blockers.description: RESOLVED 2026-09-01 (252c5b3). The sortable-column reorder-rollback failure was a test-side race, not a regression from 81568db. useReorderColumns raises the toast inside the transition's async body, but useOptimistic drops the optimistic order only when the transition completes; the test asserted order synchronously right after polling for the toast. board-view.test.tsx:1423 covers the same production path, already polls, and has never flaked. Both rollback cases (ERROR and CONFLICT) now poll. Six consecutive full runs green (3 pre-fix, 3 post-fix), 1659/1659 each; tsc/lint/comments:check clean; negative control fails by timeout in both device variants.

decisions.decision: Optimistic UI uses React useOptimistic, not TanStack Query's optimistic-updates guide
decisions.rationale: The board arrives as RSC props and ADR tech/0019 keeps reads out of the query cache, so setQueryData has nothing to write to. Applied to BOTH the task-move and column-reorder overrides.

decisions.decision: The add-task context bridge is KEPT, not deleted
decisions.rationale: BoardView publishes renderedColumns - the optimistic tail of the rename/reorder/move chain - not the server's columns. A server-side feed would show a renamed column's OLD name in the Add Task Status list until refresh landed. The header also sits above the [boardId] segment and context does not flow upward. Renamed for clarity instead.

decisions.rationale: User's call, for one mechanism rather than two. useOptimistic cannot serve the board rename anyway: app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx streams the sidebar and header as independent Suspense boundaries with no common client owner. Recorded against advice for the two drag sites; see tech/0029 Consequences.
